newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank Q1 oper profit up 18.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank Q1 oper profit up 18.7 pct.

text.p: Three months to March 31 (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Group oper profit before provisions 614.7 vs 517.7
NOTE - Full name of the German bank is Bayerische Vereinsbank AG. The results were released in a mandatory statement ahead of the bank's annual shareholder meeting.
Group balance sheet total 409,600 up 1.5 pct
NOTE - The bank said the rise in its trading income followed improved earnings in almost equal measure from fixed income securities, currencies and equities.

While personnel costs rose only slightly, the stronger rise of 10.4 percent to 417.3 million marks in other costs was due to continued spending on technology and expanding profitable business segments, the bank said.

Vereinsbank said it almost managed to match the "extraordinarily strong" mortgage lending new business of the first quarter of 1996 in the 1997 first quarter, with a total new business volume of eight billion marks, down 0.8 percent.
Total mortgage loans were down 3.1 percent at 12.7 billion marks. Home lending rose 4.5 percent to 5.7 billion marks.
